name: Chip
description: A compact value: a tag, a filter or an applied selection, in one untoned look.

children.description: Chip label; truncates when the chip runs out of room

selected.description: Selected state. Setting it (or onClick, or Chip.Group) makes the chip a toggle button with aria-pressed; selected paints the selection wash and ring

onRemove.description: Makes the chip removable: an X control with its own label and a micro hit area

removeLabel.description: Accessible name of the remove control; defaults to "Remove <label>" for a text label

value.description: Value identifier used by Chip.Group for selection tracking

disabled.description: Dims the chip once and disables its controls

onClick.description: Click handler; makes the chip a button

when: Filtering a list by tag or category
Showing filters the user can dismiss
whenNot: A main call to action — use Button
guidelines: One to three words per chip; long labels truncate
One look, never toned: a chip that reports a state is a Badge
A static tag renders a span; it becomes a button only when it selects or clicks
Chip.Group when chips share selection state; name it with aria-label
onRemove only when the chip is genuinely dismissible
Pass an explicit value when children are custom JSX
accessibility: A selectable chip is a toggle button; selection is reported via aria-pressed
A static tag is plain text, not a button
Chip.Group renders role="group" and needs aria-label or aria-labelledby
The remove control carries its own label ("Remove design") and a 24px hit area
Disabled chips are skipped by keyboard and pointer

examples.name: Tag
examples.description: A static tag: a span, no button.

examples.name: Selectable
examples.description: A toggle: the selection wash with the ring as its edge.
examples.code:
const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState(true);

<Chip selected={selected} onClick={() => setSelected((value) => !value)}>
  Open
</Chip>

examples.name: Removable
examples.description: The X control has its own label and a micro hit area.

examples.name: Group
examples.code:
const [value, setValue] = React.useState(['open']);

<Chip.Group aria-label="Status filters" value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
  <Chip value="open">Open</Chip>
  <Chip value="draft">Draft</Chip>
  <Chip value="merged">Merged</Chip>
</Chip.Group>

relations.note: Badge reports a state in colour; Chip is an untoned value, static or selectable
Use ToggleGroup for mutually exclusive options
Use Button for primary actions, Chip for selection/filtering

propsSummary: selected: boolean - toggle state via aria-pressed, selection wash and ring
icon: ReactNode - leading glyph or avatar
Chip.Group: value / defaultValue / onValueChange(string[]), role=group, aria-label required
